definition: לֶ֫קֶשׁ noun [masculine] probably after-growth, after-math , i.e. spring-crop (compare GASm 12 Proph. i. 109 ); — only (2 t.) Amos 7:1 , בִּתְחִלַּת עֲלוֺת הַלָּ֑קֶשׁ וְהִנֵּה לֶקֶשׁ אַחַר נִּזֵּי הַמֶּלֶךְ׃ . — > Other interpretations are: late-rain growth (from מַלְקוֺשׁ q. v.), Hoffm ZAW iii. (1883) 116 ; leaf-and-herb-gathering in spring, We after Klein ZPV iv. 1881, 83 ; Anderlind viii. 1886, 62 .
